label: Isometric
description: Isometric icon stack. Best for the minimal pattern: default size, neutral tone and one small layers glyph.

label: Sizes
description: Icon stack sizes. Best for small, default and large stacks side by side with captions, the glyph growing with them.

label: Colors

label: Item Media
description: Item media stack. Best for the smallest stack in the set as the media of an outlined row with a title and description.
